scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Hey there, I came here to Prontera in search of an old lady who can remove cards from slots. Do you know where I can find her?
Yes
No
Oooo, could you please tell me where she's at? I'd be really appreciative.
Swordsman Association
Sanctuary
Prontera Chivalry
Trading Post
Kit Shop
Inn
Armory
Library
Job Agency
Prontera Castle
City Hall

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Hmm... I dunno why she would be there... guess I'll take a look.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Wow I never knew she was a religious person... I'll see to it thanks.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Hmm.... are you sure about that?

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Why would she need to go there? I think you might be mistaken.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: The only thing she'd need at a Kit shop is medicine for her rheumatism. She's probably long gone from there by now.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: I don't think she needs to be there, she LIVES here in Prontera.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Ah I see, if she's studying then I don't want to bother her. Thanks anyways.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Job Agency?  I don't think so.  Don't lead me all around Prontera please! She's already a teacher here.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: The castle eh, I don't want to step in there... just doesn't feel like my style. I don't like that noble feeling of importance type of thing.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: O wow, did she become an important part of Prontera? I'd think she's too busy for me to visit. I'll try again later.

scripts.speaker: Mason
scripts.text: Ah, I heard that her class was somewhere around there... thanks a lot! Here's a lil something for your help.
Yay, I found her! Thank you very much for you help!
Hi! I came here to Prontera in search of an old lady... But...
Oh.. Ok.. Thanks anyways.

scripts.speaker: Mojo
scripts.text:
Oh no!  I lost my teacher's ^FF0000old magic book^000000!
What am I going to do... those dumb Bathory...
I lost my teacher's book!  What am I going to do...

scripts.speaker: Marie
scripts.text: Hello, is there something you need?
No nothing at all.
Your teacher sent me.

scripts.speaker: Marie
scripts.text: What does he want from me?

scripts.speaker: Marie
scripts.text: Oh wait, I see... he wants his reference scroll back am I right? Well, I'm kinda still using it buuut... I'll give it back if you can gimme a poring egg and an incubator. Those things are so cute!
Hi! What do you want from me?

scripts.speaker: Marie
scripts.text: Hrrmm okay? Cya then..
Heyyy there, you have a poring egg and the pet incubator to go with it! Are those for me?
Yep!
Sorry, no.

scripts.speaker: Marie
scripts.text: Yatta!  Here's a lil something in return.
Oh.. pooo... sigh...
Yay! I love Porings!

scripts.speaker: Fabius
scripts.text: You speak Umbalian fluently! So you will never forget the language of Umbalians!

Ah, you've done well in retrieving my references. These artifacts holds information about ruins around the world, from the burning hell of the Magma Dungeon, to the strange eerie Hidden Forest of Yggdrasil.

scripts.speaker: Fabius
scripts.text: But enough talk, you're just eager to get your reward aren't you?  Well it may not sound much, but my reward for you is knowledge...

scripts.speaker: Fabius
scripts.text: Actually it is knowledge of the Umbalian people. They are connected to this world of Midgard in some special way, we just can't confirm it yet. There is a theory that they may be like the elves and protect the ancient tree of Yggdrasil.

scripts.speaker: Fabius
scripts.text: And I, a great wise man of Juno, will teach you their language!
^0000FF Learned the language of Umbalians! ^000000
Argh! My three students ran off with my references! Hey you! Can you get them back for me? I'll gladly reward you.

scripts.text: From what I know, they're in different separate towns making something out of themselves.

You saw Mojo in Aldebaran?
